notes: Letter to Coates dated 4.1.67.; pencil folio 43. It proposes the position of the index conjecture in an exposition and discusses dependence of conditions A–D on a prime-like parameter and on polarization. The repeated typed parameter has a crossed χ form; that visible form is retained in all seven places, without replacing it by an expected ℓ. The second dimension is typed C^(n−1), despite the preceding C^i; its connected numeral is clear in the crop. H reads the crossed cancelled closing parenthesis as an additional subscript. The blank after “it is independant of” is unfilled on the sheet and remains a blank. His spellings independant, choosen, one’s and bu, and the unfinished “Of cour-”, remain. The author writes “it is not clear to me” and requests attention to possible dependence; this is recorded as his uncertainty, not resolved here. No conjecture implication or independence assertion on this letter page was proved in this run.
